presets.name: Grafana Cloud
presets.description: Send logs and metrics to a Grafana Cloud stack over OTLP/HTTP.

fields.label: OTLP endpoint
fields.help: Copy it from the stack's OpenTelemetry page, without a signal path.

fields.label: Instance ID
fields.help: The numeric instance ID shown next to the OTLP endpoint.

fields.label: API token
fields.help: A cloud access policy token with the logs:write and metrics:write scopes.

hints.401: The instance ID or token was rejected. Check that the instance ID is the number shown on the OTLP page and the token is current.
hints.403: The token is valid but lacks the logs:write or metrics:write scope. Create a new access policy with both scopes.
hints.404: The endpoint path was not found. Use the OTLP endpoint of your stack and leave out /v1/logs and /v1/metrics.

presets.name: Datadog
presets.description: Send logs to Datadog log intake. Metrics use the OTLP intake, which accepts delta temporality only, and are off by default.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: An organization API key, not an application key.

hints.401: Datadog rejected the API key. Use an API key, not an application key.
hints.403: The key is valid for another site. Pick the site that matches the URL you sign in to.
hints.404: The intake was not found for this site. Check the site value.
hints.400: Datadog rejected the payload. Its OTLP metrics intake accepts delta temporality only, and counters are exported as cumulative sums, so a metrics test may be rejected.
hints.413: The request was larger than the 5.1 MiB Datadog intake limit.

presets.name: Grafana Loki
presets.description: Send logs to a Loki push endpoint, Grafana Cloud or self-hosted. Logs only.

fields.label: Loki URL
fields.help: The Loki base URL. /loki/api/v1/push is added when no path is given.

fields.label: Username
fields.help: The Loki user or instance ID for Basic auth. Leave blank when only a tenant header is needed.

fields.label: API token
fields.help: The Basic auth password, such as a Grafana Cloud access policy token with logs:write.

fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.help: Sent as X-Scope-OrgID. Only for a multi-tenant Loki.

hints.401: Loki rejected the user or token. For Grafana Cloud use the numeric user shown on the Loki details page and a current access policy token.
hints.403: The token lacks the logs:write scope or the tenant is not allowed.
hints.404: The push path was not found. Use the base URL of your Loki, without /loki/api/v1/push.

presets.name: Axiom
presets.description: Send logs and metrics to an Axiom dataset.

fields.label: Dataset
fields.help: The dataset must already exist. Metrics need a metrics dataset.

fields.label: API token
fields.help: A token with ingest permission on the dataset.

hints.401: Axiom rejected the token. Create a new API token with ingest permission.
hints.403: The token cannot ingest into this dataset. Grant ingest on the dataset to the token.
hints.404: The dataset was not found. Create it first or check its name and region.

presets.name: Honeycomb
presets.description: Send logs and metrics to Honeycomb over OTLP/HTTP.

fields.label: Dataset (Classic only)
fields.help: Only needed for Classic environments. Leave empty otherwise.

fields.label: Ingest key
fields.help: An ingest key with permission to create datasets.

hints.401: Honeycomb rejected the key. Check the key and that the region matches your team.
hints.403: The key cannot write to this dataset. Enable the create datasets permission on the key.
hints.404: The endpoint was not found. Check the region.

presets.name: Better Stack
presets.description: Send logs to a Better Stack source. Metrics are not exported by this preset.

fields.label: Source token
fields.help: The token of an HTTP source.

hints.402: The Better Stack plan quota or spending limit was reached.
hints.403: Better Stack rejected the source token or ingesting host. Copy both again from the source settings.
hints.404: The ingest endpoint was not found for this source. Check the ingesting host.
hints.406: The request body was not valid JSON or MessagePack.
hints.413: The request body was larger than 10 MiB.

presets.name: Generic OTLP/HTTP
presets.description: Send logs and metrics to any collector or backend that accepts OTLP/HTTP.

fields.label: Auth header value
fields.help: For example Bearer followed by the token. Leave empty for an open collector.

hints.401: The collector rejected the credentials. Check the header name and value.
hints.403: The credentials are valid but not allowed to write. Check the collector's access rules.
hints.404: The collector has no OTLP/HTTP route at this URL. Check the base endpoint and that OTLP/HTTP is enabled.
hints.400: The collector rejected the payload as malformed. This is permanent, retrying will not help.
hints.413: The payload was larger than the collector accepts. Lower the batch size or raise the collector limit.
hints.429: The collector is rate limiting this sender. Delivery is retried automatically.
hints.502: The collector or a gateway in front of it is unavailable. Delivery is retried automatically.
hints.503: The collector is overloaded or unavailable. Delivery is retried automatically.
hints.504: The collector or a gateway in front of it timed out. Delivery is retried automatically.
